dog.description_text:
Mosley is a 2-year-old mixed breed who weighs around 37 lbs and is a friendly, energetic guy with a lot of love to give. One of his cutest habits is greeting his people with hugs when they come home, and he’s always happy to be part of whatever is going on.

He’s crate-trained, doing great with house-training, and has done well around dogs of all sizes. Even when other dogs bark, Mosley tends to stay quiet and keep his cool. On walks, he’s very interested in birds and will happily chase after them before watching wistfully as they fly away.

Mosley is smart, social, and full of potential. He’ll do best with adopters who can give him some structure and continue working on general training while giving him plenty of outlets for his energy.

Registered adopters interested in Mosley can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
